metadata.description: CJ's skills and mods for Claude Code: planning in any tracker, a decision log, proving work in the real app, and guards for secrets, memory and Linear writes.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Sign off UI work and motion — check it against the design, add missing microinteractions, paint scenes in code, make launch videos.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Prove the work in the real app — playbooks, design-first builds, unattended loops, bug hunts, code history, review and PRs.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Turn an idea into tickets — find and test ideas, write the spec, cut thin slices and triage them in any tracker.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Keep what the team learns — a decision log, research pages, lessons from past sessions, and a recap of recent work.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Write so people can read — docs in plain ASD-STE100, AI tells cut, and plain re-pitches and catch-ups in chat.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Apply engineering principles by name — prove it works, subtract before you add, attack the premise, and 17 more.

plugins.name: linear-gate
plugins.description: Stop Linear writes off shift — on shift, your permission mode decides; a delete or cancel asks you first.

plugins.name: session-modes
plugins.description: Keep a session in one working mode — /mode readonly, research, prototype or build blocks calls past it.

plugins.name: hone-nudge
plugins.description: Turn corrections into fixes — suggests /hone <skill> after you correct Claude during a cj-stack skill.

plugins.name: memory-lint
plugins.description: Keep memory worth relearning — denies a memory write with task state, one-off references or repo detail.

plugins.name: work-folder
plugins.description: Keep agent files out of the repo — denies new plans or evidence outside .claude/work/ and clears old ones.

plugins.name: test-guard
plugins.description: Stop tests changed to pass — denies an edit that changes or removes a test line at HEAD; additions pass.
